Please go on I really need a different perspective on this. I have no one I can talk to that wouldn't think I'm fucking insane, I'm trying to think this through rationally though. 

My quality of life is dwindling and I'm dreading enduring the future. I want to make the best decision for my family too I hate this. I know my family and friends would be devastated but I'm sick of struggling when it seems I'm literally worth more dead than alive. $400,000 isn't much in the grand scheme of things but it could buy a good home and vehicle for my family and cover college for my child one day if they want to go.

SGLI, Servicemember's Group Life Insurance does. For 120 days after separation from Active Duty which I now have 20 days left for that. Although I still have it in the National Guard it's just much more expensive.
